subject: Transient throughput uplift + reconciliation approach for BrightCart launch
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@brightcart.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — launch weekend capacity and how you’d bill it

Hi Nikhil,

We have a large product launch slated for next weekend (Sept 11–13) and are expecting traffic to spike briefly — our internal forecast shows a 2.5x token throughput bump for around 48 hours. We want to avoid throttles or degraded latency for customers.

Questions:
- Can Redwood provide a temporary quota uplift for that window?
- If we go over, how will overages be billed? We’d prefer a blended/discounted overrun rate versus a sudden step-up.
- Any quick playbooks you suggest so we don’t have to renegotiate if we go over by a lot?

I attached a small forecast (launch_forecast_v3.xlsx) with expected hourly curves. We’d like a short call today or tomorrow to lock plans — 15–30m.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Patel
Head of Product Operations, BrightCart
launch-team@brightcart.com
(External)

Attachment: launch_forecast_v3.xlsx (Excel, 230KB)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — launch weekend capacity and how you’d bill it

Hi Aisha — thanks for the forecast, and congrats on the launch. We can support a short-term uplift; below is a pragmatic approach that keeps your latency SLOs intact and minimizes surprise billing.

Proposed plan (summary):
1) Immediate soft uplift: provision a short-lived quota increase to cover ~2.5x baseline for a 72-hour window. This raises the quota so requests aren’t throttled; cores will be allocated from our shared pool.
2) Emergency overrun bucket: any consumption beyond the uplifted quota during the window will be tracked in a separate overrun bucket and billed at a blended surcharge. We can offer a provisional blended overrun price 25% above your current committed rate for the first 100% excess, then standard overage tiers after that.
3) Retro reconciliation: after the window we’ll run a reconciliation (usage_snapshot_sep03.csv) and apply a one-time launch credit if your overrun exceeds 200% of the expected uplift (proposed credit: USD 10,000).

Attachments: provisional_surge_plan.pdf (one-page summary), MA_draft_terms.docx (draft amendment with uplift and billing clauses).

Next steps:
- Approve the uplift window / size (I proposed 72 hours to be conservative).
- If approved, I’ll route for a quick finance sign-off and schedule a capacity check with Ben to confirm no infra blockers.
- We can do a 20-min call today 11:00–12:00 PT or tomorrow morning if that works.

If you prefer a firmer price instead of a blended surcharge we can discuss a temporary fixed-rate packet for the 72-hour window.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai
(attachment: provisional_surge_plan.pdf; MA_draft_terms.docx)

Looping you in — this is BrightCart (BRG-4587). They want a short window uplift; forecast attached. My provisional offer: 72-hour soft uplift to 2.5x baseline + blended overrun surcharge (+25% first-band) + $10k launch credit trigger if >200% overrun.

Marissa — can we approve a discretionary concession here (blended surcharge vs our usual overage rate)? They’re an active pipeline opportunity; I’m proposing to commit a blended 25% surcharge for the first overrun band and reserve the $10k launch credit as a conditional marketing-style concession.

Ben — can you confirm we can support an immediate 72-hour uplift without dedicated nodes? If not, estimate what Dedicated add-ons we’d need and lead time. Also confirm any latencies we should call out in the doc.

Notes:
- If finance wants a stricter cap, alternate path is a short-term prepaid headroom bucket for the 72 hours billed at a fixed uplift rate.
- I’m aiming for a quick yes/no so we can confirm the uplift before their engineering freeze end of day tomorrow.

Thanks — Nikhil

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed uplift & billing path for Sept 11–13 launch window

Hi Aisha — quick update after internal alignment. We’ve signed off on a pragmatic package that should give you headroom and predictable economics. Summary below — please reply to accept and we’ll push the uplift live and send the amendment.

Confirmed terms (BrightCart — Sept 11 00:00 PT through Sept 13 23:59 PT):
- Provisioned uplift: soft quota increase to cover 2.8x your baseline (slightly above your 2.5x forecast as buffer). Window: 72 hours.
- Overrun handling: any consumption beyond the uplifted quota during that window goes into an overrun bucket. Billing for overrun: blended surcharge of +22% above your committed rate for the first 150% of excess; excess beyond that billed at standard overage tiers.
- Launch protection credit: conditional one-time credit of USD 10,000 if total overrun > 200% of uplift volume. Credit will be applied on the next invoice post-reconciliation.
- Optional opt-in: prepaid headroom at a fixed uplift rate (if you want strict cost ceiling) — we can convert the provisional uplift to this model tomorrow morning if preferred.

Operational notes:
- Ben confirmed we can provision the uplift from shared pool without Dedicated nodes; no infra change required. If real-time latencies spike we will automatically route traffic to warmed fallback instances in the same region.
- We’ll snapshot hourly usage during the window and reconcile within 5 business days after the window closes (you’ll get the usage_snapshot_sep03.csv output and a short reconciliation report).

Next steps:
1) Aisha — confirm acceptance by replying here.
2) Upon acceptance, I’ll create the amendment and route for signatures (MA_draft_terms.docx updated); uplift will be enabled ~2 hours after signature.
3) We’ll run the reconciliation and apply any launch credit where applicable.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the numbers (I’ve left Ben on the thread for infra details).

Best regards,
Nikhil Sharma
